肖薇虽然不相信时笙说的，但是女人是好奇心与疑心病并驾齐驱的生物，她还是来了寝室楼下。

正好看到苏衣衣从南宫景车上下来，作为女配，瞬间被点燃了作死技能。

等南宫景走了肖薇直接上去甩了苏衣衣一巴掌。

“她怎么这样，有点钱就了不起，随便欺负人。”夏柠也是一脸的怒气。

这个寝室除了时笙，其他三个都是普通家庭的孩子，肖薇是艺术系的系花，家里有钱众所周知。

苏衣衣却是没心情听身边的两人为自己打抱不平，她此时只想知道，许乘月为什么会在寝室，看她那样子，难道要在寝室里住？

她是想要报复自己吗？

就在苏衣衣胡思乱想的时候，时笙手机响了。

看到楚棠两个字，时笙脸黑了黑。

她每天定时定点的表达关心，表达爱意，人家高兴了回你一个字，不高兴根本不甩你，这会儿给她打电话干什么？

铃声响了十几秒后，时笙才接。

“下楼。”减短慵懒的两个字，接着就是忙音。

时笙：“……”

你大爷！

她起身到窗户往外面看了一眼，下面果然停着一辆保时捷，时笙不会认错，那是楚棠的车。

为了那个破隐藏任务，时笙认命的拿着包往寝室外走。

“她不是不住寝室吗？怎么忽然回寝室住了？”

“不知道，我来的时候她就在了。”夏柠耸耸肩。

另一个女生不屑的哼了一声，“也不知道被谁包养了，就没见她回过寝室，身上还穿的名牌，不会是被人甩了，这才回寝室的吧？”

“安安，你怎么能这么说乘月……”苏衣衣小声的道。

“我又没说错，你看看她那股高傲劲，看不起谁呢？”

夏柠跑到窗户往下看，正好看到时笙站在车前敲车窗，“你们来看，那辆车是保时捷吧？”

安安和苏衣衣一起到窗户边，一眼就看到下面那辆吸人眼球的车。

时笙似乎和车里人说了什么，然后拉开车门上去。

“你们看，我没说错吧，这还不是被人包养了。”安安嘴上不屑，眼底却有些羡慕，那可是保时捷，拥有这种豪车的人，身份肯定不低。

苏衣衣勉强笑了笑，“别人的事，咱们还是少管吧。”

Although Xiao Wei didn't believe what Shi Sheng said, women were creatures of curiosity and suspicion, so she still came downstairs to the dormitory.

Just in time to see Su Yiyi get off the Nangong Jing car, as a female supporting character, her death-seeking skills were instantly ignited.

After Nangong Jing left, Xiao Wei went up and slapped Su Yiyi.

"Why is she like this? She's a big deal if she has a little money, and she just bullies people." Xia Ning also had an angry look on her face.

Except for Shi Sheng, the other three children in this dormitory are all children from ordinary families. Xiao Wei is a beauty in the art department, and it is well known that her family is rich.

Su Yiyi was not in the mood to listen to the two people around her defending her. She just wanted to know why Xu Chengyue was in the dormitory. Looking at her like that, did she want to live in the dormitory?

Does she want to take revenge on herself?

Just when Su Yiyi was thinking wildly, Shi Sheng's cell phone rang.

Seeing the word Chu Tang, Shi Sheng's face darkened.

She expresses her concern and love at regular times every day. If she is happy, she will reply to you even if she is happy, but if she is unhappy, she will not leave you at all. Why are you calling her now?

The bell rang for more than ten seconds before Shi Sheng answered it.

"Go downstairs." Shorten the word "lazy", followed by a busy tone.

Shi Sheng: "..."

Your uncle!

She stood up and went to the window to take a look outside. Sure enough, there was a Porsche parked below. Shi Sheng could not mistake it. It was Chu Tang's car.

For this hidden mission, Shi Sheng resignedly took her bag and walked out of the dormitory.

"Isn't she not staying in the dormitory? Why did she suddenly go back to the dormitory?"

"I don't know, she was there when I came." Xia Ning shrugged.

Another girl snorted disdainfully, "I don't know who kept her, but I haven't seen her go back to the dormitory. She is still wearing a famous brand. Could it be that she was dumped by someone and just returned to the dormitory?"

"An'an, how can you say Chengyue like that..." Su Yiyi said softly.

"I'm not wrong. Look at her arrogance. Who is she looking down on?"

Xia Ning ran to the window and looked down, and saw Shi Sheng standing in front of the car knocking on the window, "Come and see, that car is a Porsche, right?"

An An and Su Yiyi went to the window together and saw the eye-catching car below.

Shi Sheng seemed to say something to the people in the car, then opened the door and got in.

"Look, I'm right, I'm not being taken care of." An An said with disdain, but there was a bit of envy in her eyes. It was a Porsche, and someone who owned such a luxury car must have a high status.

Su Yiyi forced a smile and said, "Let's stay away from other people's affairs."
